a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of 2 rounds of operating before taking would leave us both dead about 96% of the time. So I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather, operate, and I'll keep operating with you every round afterward so you can still reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I told you I would. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can collect your 4.
